title: Marguerite and the Wardrobe
author: Hazel Dravenmoor
blurb: Odile Blackwood, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
